body.p: Akkalow's son died at Nugumiut. During the same winter Akkalow went to Naujatelik. He was sad and angry, and determined to kill some one; but when the people noticed his state of mind, Egeewaping stabbed and killed him. He believed that Akkalow had intended to kill the husband of a woman named Unaq.
